candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms CF with F508del/3849+10kbC-T mutation, making C001 the underlying condition. However, the benchmark reference is the specific complication: Burkholderia cenocepacia-associated paranasal sinusitis, supported by CT confirmation of paranasal sinus inflammatory changes, nasal lavage fluid isolates, MALDI-TOF/WGS taxonomic confirmation, and protein profile homogeneity of isolates 2015-2020. C001 names only the parent disease without the infectious etiology or anatomical specificity required.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the underlying genetic disease (CF with specific mutations) but omits the specific infectious complication (Burkholderia cenocepacia) and the specific anatomical site (paranasal sinuses) that constitute the benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Benchmark diagnosis requires Burkholderia cenocepacia identification which is implied by MALDI-TOF/WGS and longitudinal isolate homogeneity but the organism name is not explicitly stated in the record text
Lung CT negative for damage while paranasal sinuses show inflammatory changes supports sinusitis as the primary locus of infection
